invented: Step 1 of the first test assumes the user is signed in during account recovery (precondition: kullanıcı oturum açmıştır), which the requirement does not state.

The first test assumes the new code is delivered to the user (email or portal); the assumption is written down, but the requirement only says the code is issued.
